repo.name: gocheat
repo.description: A beautiful customizable TUI Cheatsheet for keybindings,hotkeys and more in the terminal

readme.summary: Well-structured documentation with clear purpose and installation, but lacks immediate usage examples and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No quick start example showing how to add your first entry or basic workflow - video demo is helpful but text example would be clearer

injection_risks.description: The jsonTemplate variable is defined as a map and then marshaled into JSON. While this does not pose an immediate injection risk, it could potentially be exploited if the template is modified to include user-controlled data.
The AddItemToList function appends user input directly to the config.GoCheatOptions.Items slice. This could potentially be exploited if an attacker is able to manipulate the input data.

critical_findings: Lack of input validation and sanitization
Potential for injection risks due to user-controlled data being written to the config file
security.summary: The gocheat package has some security concerns, including potential injection risks and lack of input validation, but does not appear to have any critical vulnerabilities.

common_complaints: UI/display limitations (viewing more lines, layout customization)
Missing user experience features (filter mode indicator, edit existing items)
Critical bug causing crashes (negative Repeat count panic)
praise_themes: Active user engagement with feature requests
